record.original_question:
For 0 < b < 1, define ψ_b ∈ L2(R) by ψ̂_b = 1_{(−1,−b)∪(b,1)}.

A frame wavelet is a function ψ whose dyadic wavelet system {ψ_{j,k}(x) := 2^{j/2} ψ(2^j x − k)} is a frame for L2(R) with bounds 0 < c ≤ d < ∞.

For what values of 1/8 < b ≤ 1/6 is ψ_b a frame wavelet?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let the Fourier transform on $L^2(\mathbb{R})$ be normalized by $\hat{\psi}(\xi)=\int_{\mathbb{R}}\psi(x)e^{-2\pi i x\xi}\,dx$ for $\psi\in L^1(\mathbb{R})\cap L^2(\mathbb{R})$, extended to $L^2(\mathbb{R})$ in the usual way. For a function $\psi\in L^2(\mathbb{R})$, define the dyadic wavelet system
$$\psi_{j,k}(x):=2^{j/2}\psi(2^j x - k),\qquad j,k\in\mathbb{Z}.$$
Call $\psi$ a frame wavelet if there exist constants $0<c\le d<\infty$ such that
$$c\,\|f\|_2^2\;\le\;\sum_{j,k\in\mathbb{Z}}|\langle f,\psi_{j,k}\rangle|^2\;\le\;d\,\|f\|_2^2\qquad\text{for all }f\in L^2(\mathbb{R}).$$
For each $0<b<1$, define $\psi_b\in L^2(\mathbb{R})$ by
$$\hat{\psi}_b=\mathbf{1}_{(-1,-b)\cup(b,1)}.$$
Determine, for $b$ in the range $1/8 < b \le 1/6$, exactly those values of $b$ for which $\psi_b$ is a frame wavelet.

Related work on frame wavelets with frame-set support in the frequency domain exists, but no source verifying the specific case was located.

status_evidence.snippet: Studies frame wavelets defined as indicator functions on subsets of the frequency domain, but does not appear to settle the specific range 1/8 < b ≤ 1/6.
status_evidence.claim: The general framework of frame wavelets given by indicator functions has been studied, but the specific interval 1/8 < b ≤ 1/6 is not resolved in the located sources.
